title: REQ · Scheduler is built from config and started in main
summary: main runs the round scheduler built by server.NewScheduler
description: Context: server.NewScheduler wires round.Service, round.FileStore, a world lister and cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval; main.go launches it with go Run(ctx). Desired behavior: scheduler is constructed from config with controller and store set. Expected result: NewScheduler returns a scheduler with the configured interval. Why: rounds must open and close automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Given round.scheduler_interval 7s, when NewScheduler is built, then Interval is 7s
Given a temp repo_path, when NewScheduler is built, then Controller and Rounds are non-nil
technical_constraints: Scheduler uses the injected config only
definition_of_done: NewScheduler wired and started in main
